_README: Label id -> structure name for the Visible Human FEMALE rotator-cuff volume (scripts/cryo/vhf_rotator_cuff_from_cryo.py: the male's scapular-surface rules on her registered cryosection photographs, anchored on her TotalSegmentator scapula label), plus the mapping onto atlas entities.

A KEY, not data. Rule-based: muscle within 25 mm of the scapula by nearest surface (ventral = subscapularis; dorsal above the spine level and medial to the glenoid = supraspinatus; else infraspinatus with teres minor merged); boundaries are rules, not traced fascia; badge it.
Reclassified with the female colour classes (scripts/cryo/cryo_classes_f.py, 2026-09-12).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female cryosections and CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons; TotalSegmentator v2.18.0 labels as anchors.

supraspinatus_right.note: Supraspinous fossa by level and glenoid rule; over-inclusive at the tendon.

infraspinatus_right.note: Dorsal scapular surface below the spine level; teres minor merged in.

subscapularis_right.note: Ventral scapular surface, more than 8 mm from the ribs.

supraspinatus_left.note: Supraspinous fossa by level and glenoid rule; over-inclusive at the tendon.

infraspinatus_left.note: Dorsal scapular surface below the spine level; teres minor merged in.

subscapularis_left.note: Ventral scapular surface, more than 8 mm from the ribs.
